_comment: The welcome a brand-new player sees before choosing their look, and again any time from the gear menu (Welcome). One entry per page; 'body' is a list of short paragraphs; an optional 'tip' adds a line of small print. Edit freely: scripts/presentation/welcome_panel.gd only lays it out. 'finish_first_run' labels the last button on the first-run welcome (it leads into the wardrobe); 'finish_again' labels it when reopened from the gear menu.

pages.heading: A place to be, not a task.
body: Kithbound is a gentle world to wander, linger in, and share with friends.
There's nothing to win and no way to lose. Just places to explore, and someone to explore them with.

pages.heading: Somewhere nearby, a companion is waiting.
body: Everyone here is bound to one creature: a partner who follows you everywhere, shifts its shape now and then, and slowly grows to reflect who you are.
Yours is hiding among a little flock of wild ones. Walk up close and Examine them. You'll know yours when you find it.
pages.tip: Move with WASD, the arrow keys, or the on-screen stick. Space or Enter (or the Examine bubble) looks at what's near you.

pages.heading: Through the Gateway, other worlds.
body: The Vale is where you'll start. Its great Gateway opens onto other worlds, and each one hides a secret.
What you find is written in your journal, and your home grows with it. Bring friends: it's all better together.
